subject.title: Theme Customization System — Preset Themes + Custom Theme Studio

question: Should Control UI theming remain Claw/Knot/Dash plus one browser-local tweakcn import slot, or should OpenClaw sponsor an in-product preset/theme-studio model with broader persistence?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally expose a narrower one-slot import model, while this issue requests a larger built-in authoring and persistence surface that affects product design rather than a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Define a narrow built-in theming roadmap
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify which preset picker, preview, studio, and persistence pieces belong in core before implementation starts.

options.title: Keep the tweakcn-only model
options.body: If maintainers want to avoid a larger core theme studio, document that decision and close this issue as out of scope after preserving the tweakcn/import alternative.

options.title: Split into smaller tracked slices
options.body: Move interactive preview, gateway-backed persistence, accessibility presets, and local override editing into separate product-approved issues if maintainers want staged delivery.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow built-in theming roadmap
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify which preset picker, preview, studio, and persistence pieces belong in core before implementation starts.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev is assigned on the live issue and authored the current tweakcn theming path that this request would extend or replace.
